dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 23, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Cardinals Sweep Reds, Astros Shut Down Cubs in Shutout**

The St. Louis Cardinals took the first game of a doubleheader against the Cincinnati Reds 8-1, with Iván Herrera leading the offense. Alec Burleson and Jordan Walker each contributed with a hit and a run scored, while Bryan Torres hit a home run in the win. Andre Pallante earned the win in relief of the Cardinals' staff effort.

In the second game, the Cardinals fell to the Reds 7-6, with Jordan Walker hitting a home run and driving in four runs. However, the Reds' Kyle Leahy shut down the Cardinals' offense in the final inning, allowing just one hit in the 7th. Pierce Johnson earned the win for the Reds.

In the American League, the Houston Astros blanked the Chicago Cubs 3-0, with Christian Walker hitting two home runs and driving in three runs. Kai-Wei Teng pitched six scoreless innings, striking out six and earning the win.

The San Francisco Giants dominated the Chicago White Sox 10-3, with Harrison Bader hitting a home run and driving in four runs. Matt Gage earned the win, striking out four in 1.1 innings of relief.

The Kansas City Royals shut down the Seattle Mariners 5-0, with Stephen Kolek pitching a complete game shutout, striking out two and allowing just four hits.

The Minnesota Twins edged the Boston Red Sox 4-2, with Trevor Larnach hitting four hits and driving in no runs. Taj Bradley earned the win, striking out seven in five innings.

The Washington Nationals blanked the Atlanta Braves 2-0, with Jorbit Vivas hitting a home run and driving in one run. Grant Holmes pitched five scoreless innings, striking out ten and taking the loss.

The Miami Marlins beat the New York Mets 4-1, with Liam Hicks hitting two home runs and driving in two runs. Max Meyer earned the win, striking out eight in seven innings.

The Los Angeles Dodgers crushed the Milwaukee Brewers 11-3, with Teoscar Hernández hitting a home run and driving in six runs. Roki Sasaki earned the win, striking out four in two innings.

The San Diego Padres beat the Athletics 2-0, with Lucas Giolito earning the win, striking out four in 2.2 innings.
